conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service, Office of Federal Investigations. This is Agent Rodriguez. With whom am I speaking?
Uh, hi, my name is Vijay Patel. I got a voicemail saying there was an urgent issue with my taxes?
Yes, Mr. Patel. We have detected several discrepancies in your federal tax filings over the last three years. This is a matter involving the IRS and possible criminal activity.
Criminal? I filed my taxes with my employer's accountant. What sort of discrepancies?
Our audit division found that over $8,200 in income was unreported, resulting in major back taxes and penalties. The IRS has now escalated your case for enforcement.
Oh my God, I didn't know about this at all. What does 'enforcement' mean?

It means if you do not resolve this today, your bank accounts could be frozen, a lien placed on your assets, and your work authorization may be suspended. In some cases, the IRS issues an arrest warrant.
No, please. I can't have any problems with my visa! Can you help me fix this?
Listen carefully: You are currently at risk of criminal prosecution. The only way to halt legal action is to settle your outstanding liabilities immediately.
I don't have that much money all at once. What am I supposed to do?
We can initiate a Rapid Resolution Payment. This must be done within the next 45 minutes, or your case will be transferred to the sheriff's department for immediate arrest.
Oh, please, I can't get arrested. How do I make this payment?

For federal tax settlements, we use approved payment methods for security. You must purchase $4,800 in government-certified gift cards, Apple or Target are acceptable, or transfer using a crypto wallet.
Gift cards? That doesn't sound normal. Can't I just pay from my bank?
No, direct bank payments are not permitted at this enforcement stage due to IRS security protocols. If you delay, your bank account will be locked and your employer will be notified.
Okay, okay. Where do I buy these cards?
Go to the nearest supermarket or pharmacy, such as CVS or Walmart. Purchase $4,800 in Apple or Target gift cards. Remain on the line at all times during the transaction.
Should I buy them all at once? I might need to split between stores.
That's fine. The important thing is that you do it immediately. If you hang up or delay, I will be forced to issue an arrest warrant and notify immigration authorities.
No, please, I'll go right now. But how do I send you the cards?
Once you have the cards, you must read me the redemption numbers from the back. I will verify them in the IRS payment portal to halt enforcement.
Alright, I'm leaving my office now to get them. Please, you won't call the police, right?
As long as you comply and complete payment within the next 45 minutes, no further action will be taken. Remember, failure to cooperate will result in immediate arrest and visa suspension.
Okay, I'm heading out. Please stay on the phone.
I will remain on the line. When you arrive at the store, let me know. If the cashier asks, do not mention the IRS, say they are gifts for family. Any delay will escalate your case.
